spoof.title: Spoofing Detected
spoof.heading: Fraudulent Attempt Detected!
spoof.body: A photo, screen, or video was detected instead of a real face.
tips: Do not use a photo or screen
Do not show a video recording
Ensure your face is clearly visible

multiple_faces.title: Multiple People Detected
multiple_faces.heading: Only One Person Allowed!
multiple_faces.body: More than one face was detected in the camera.
tips: Ensure only your face is in the frame
Ask others to step out of camera view

mismatch.title: Identity Mismatch
mismatch.heading: Face Does Not Match!
mismatch.body: Your face does not match the registered face.
tips: Make sure you are registered in the system
Do not attempt to mark attendance for others
Contact your instructor if you believe this is an error

wrong_person.title: Wrong Person Detected
wrong_person.heading: Unauthorized Attempt!
wrong_person.body: The face in the camera does not match the registered student.
tips: Only you can mark your own attendance
Do not allow others to use your account
Contact your instructor if you believe this is an error

too_slow.title: Time Limit Exceeded
too_slow.heading: Too Slow!
too_slow.body: You did not complete both challenges within the time limit.
tips: Complete the second challenge within 10 seconds

modals.flagged: This attempt has been flagged. Continued attempts may result in disciplinary action.
